skill.name: Ixtal's Impact
skill.description: Skarner charges forward and passes through terrain. If he collides with a champion or large monster, he'll slam them into the next wall he hits to damage and stun them.

skill.name: Shattered Earth / Upheaval
skill.description: Skarner rips a boulder from the earth that empowers his attacks and can be thrown as a powerful projectile.

skill.name: Lacerate
skill.description: Ambessa whips her twin drakehounds around herself, damaging and slowing nearby enemies. Initiating Drakehound's Step from this ability causes her to strike a second time at the end of its dash.

skill.name: Enchanted Crystal Arrow
skill.description: Ashe fires a missile of ice in a straight line. If the arrow collides with an enemy Champion, it deals damage and stuns the Champion, stunning for longer the farther arrow has traveled. In addition, surrounding enemy units take damage and are slowed.

skill.name: The Weirding
skill.description: Aurora converges the realms, sending out a blast of spirit magic that damages and slows enemies before Aurora hops backward to safety.

skill.name: Between Worlds
skill.description: Aurora leaps in a direction of her choosing, releasing a shockwave that damages and slows any enemies it hits. Afterward, she creates an area that slows enemies within it and allows Aurora to teleport from one side of the area to the other.

skill.name: Rupture
skill.description: Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air, dealing damage and slowing them.

skill.name: Feral Scream
skill.description: Cho'Gath unleashes a terrible scream at enemies in a cone, dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds.

skill.name: Vorpal Spikes
skill.description: Cho'Gath's attacks release deadly spikes, dealing damage and slowing all enemy units in front of him.

skill.name: Neurotoxin / Venomous Bite
skill.description:
Human Form: Deals damage based upon how high the target's Health is.

Spider Form: Lunges at an enemy and deals damage based upon how low their Health is.

passive.name: Dauntless Instinct
passive.description:
K'Sante's Abilities mark targets to take more damage on his next Attack.

When All Out, K'Sante deals more damage with all Attacks and Abilities.

skill.name: Path Maker
skill.description:
K'Sante charges up, taking reduced damage, then dashes, knocking back and stunning enemies.

When All Out, deals increased damage and no longer knocks back or stuns.

passive.name: Iron Ambassador
passive.description: Poppy throws her buckler that bounces off the target. Poppy can pick it up to gain a temporary shield.

skill.name: Heroic Charge
skill.description: Poppy dashes to the target and pushes it back. If the target is pushed into a wall, it is stunned.

skill.name: High Note
skill.description: Seraphine deals damage in an area.

skill.name: Eulogy of the Isles
skill.description: Yorick summons the Maiden of the Mist that causes Yorick's attacks against the Maiden's target to deal bonus damage. The Maiden will also automatically raise Walkers from dead enemies.

skill.name: Shadow Slash
skill.description: Zed and his Shadows slash, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Enemies hit by a Shadow's slash are slowed.
